scope: Bounded CPU/synthetic-only final review; no real-owner audio, model, library scan, network, browser, Adobe, service, GPU or video/full-mix render
fixtures: Injected stdlib WAV encoder plus one default PyAV PCM audition on a two-second synthetic 8kHz mono window; no external FFmpeg process

live_validation.blocker: Suite owns authentication, job-bound routes/UI/native and current inference lease. No normal running-app audition or owner listening was attempted.

findings.trigger: Set the snapshot input-size cap below a tiny source fixture size
findings.expected: Reject an oversized input before hashing its entire source
findings.impact: The size cap prevents snapshot copying but does not prevent the earlier whole-source verification hash. A very large source can consume disk I/O before rejection. No large file was created or read by this probe.
